steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hey, you guys over there! Don't all gather in one spot, swim further away so you're not all crammed together!
The man she points at immediately swims in the direction Eleven shows him, the floating figures of the guests on the blue sea forming a carefully crafted painting.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Good, very good, just like that. Next... Hmm, there should be enough shells and starfish on the beach for people to gather. You guys, follow my orders and go fetch some!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A & B
steps.content: On it!

The beach has become Eleven's kingdom. Initially, her voice could only influence the guests' actions when stopping dangerous behaviors, but she quickly discovers that its range of function is growing.
As she gains better control of her voice, Eleven can now freely manipulate others' will with it, using it to create her ideal beach. A stress-free, soothing, and relaxing place.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But why do they... obey my voice so readily?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Obey? Can't you see? Some people just need a guiding voice, need to be controlled, so they don't do things that harm themselves or others...
"There are words other than slander and flattery in this world."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Uh... Who's that...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Never doubt yourself! They need your voice!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Uh... My voice... My voice can be heard by anyone! My voice is worthy! Everyone... must listen to me properly!
Eleven clutches her head in pain, crouching down instinctively, fumbling in the sand. Soon, she finds another white conch and holds it to her ear like a lifeline.
The anticipated compliments soon come from the conch, soothing Eleven's strained nerves.

steps.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
steps.content: Eleven, you've done well... That's how you should use your voice. This is the best way...

steps.speaker: Gentle Male Voice
steps.content: Look how wonderful the beach is now... All thanks to your voice...

steps.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
steps.content: Yes, your voice deserves to be heard and valued... It's far more precious than those trivial noises...

steps.speaker: Gentle Male & Female Voice
steps.content: You should use it to make everything better...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Make everything better... Yes, my voice can make this place better! As long as you all listen to me, it surely can!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Find more conches! Tidy the messy beach chairs! Don't leave wrappers and trash here. Clean them all up!
Eleven's voice spreads far and wide in waves, motivating everyone on the beach to act strictly according to her instructions.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Wow, look at you, Eleven. You sure have turned the beach into a fun place!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Now you've made all of them your voice-controlled toys, haven't you? They'll do whatever you tell them to do!

The blue-haired girl suddenly emerges behind Eleven, who is gripping the conch. 
L.L. grabs her shoulders amiably and helps her supervise the guests as they bustle around like worker ants.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Don't you feel like a queen overseeing her subjects? This beach has truly become your kingdom. Are you glad? Isn't it delightful?!
L.L. waves her hand and leads Eleven up the well-built sandcastle, overlooking the people whose minds and actions are controlled by her voice.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You two... dance with each other! You three! Roll from this side of the beach to the other!
Following Eleven, L.L. also keeps ordering the people on the beach to do this and that, watching them get dragged here and there like puppets.
But suddenly, Eleven hears a ringtone from the conch in her hand.
A faint red light glows around the conch, and Eleven can't help but bring it to her ear.
Eleven? Can you hear me?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes. Your voice... sounds familiar...
Eleven wants to hear more clearly, but the familiar voice disappears with a buzz. She shakes the conch twice, but the voice does not return.
She immediately jumps off the sandcastle and starts searching for other conches on the beach. Sure enough, another conch in the sand is glowing and ringing.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Eleven, where are you going? Aren't you going to keep ordering them around?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hello, please say a few more words. I feel that... I really need your voice.
Ignoring L.L., Eleven glances up and begins searching for the next glowing, ringing conch.
I just want to speak the truth. Listen carefully, Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The truth...
Just like when you listened to your own inner voice. Believe in yourself.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Wait, Chief? Is that you? Are you looking for me?
Don't worry. We will find your true voice. The voice in your heart.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The voice... in my heart...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I... What I once forgot and lost is the voice in my heart!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Chief, is it you?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Is it you who's once again... woken me up?
The last conch turns into white sand by Eleven's ear, flowing down through her fingers.

To L.L.'s surprise, Eleven who was previously indulging in control seems to have found an anchor point, breaking free from the temptations from the beach and the conches, now going determinedly in another direction.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The person who called her... must be very important to her. Otherwise, how could just a few words have taken her away?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: She was so happy here...
